cue.label: С заданным тонусом
cue.definition: Prescribed CUE_TONE lower bounds, as in physics.json.

noCue.label: Без заданного тонуса
noCue.definition: No prescribed CUE_TONE lower bounds; equilibrium, passive tissues and all other model assumptions remain.

definitions.a: Active muscle force divided by maximum isometric force; the existing displayed effort, not neural activation. Values retain the physics.json rounding.
definitions.activation: FMAX-weighted mean of solver activation variables within the left muscle unit; distinct from force/FMAX when force-length capacity changes.
definitions.range: Minimum and maximum of the two stored solved scenarios only. Not a confidence interval, measured inter-person variability, or proof of physiological accuracy.
definitions.floor: Complete unfiltered external floor force and its difference from body weight, before display grouping, thresholding and rounding.

limitations: Only the prescribed tonic lower bounds are changed. Geometry, strength, passive behavior, kinematics and support assumptions are held fixed.
Both scenarios are mathematical static-model solutions. Neither scenario establishes a person-specific excitation pattern or measured joint force.
No scenario range was computed for intermediate slider positions or any frame of the animated cycle.
Muscle and joint values inherit the output precision and the anatomical limitations of physics.json. Compression and shear are included only where that model defines them.
